newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips extend post-election surge to second day.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips extend post-election surge to second day.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks roared back from early losses to set another record Thursday as the market extended its post-election run-up into a second day.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 28.33 points at 6,206.04 after Wednesday's gain of 97 points. The Standard & Poor's composite index of 500 stocks also set a record with a gain of 3.05 points to 727.64.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on heavy volume of 504 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
